title: Internet Attack Surface
descriptionMarkdown: Internet Attack Surface data connector gives richer insights into security events by supplementing details about externally exposed assets and their attack surfaces. Data from this connector helps identify and monitor internet-facing resources, vulnerabilities, and potential security risks across your organization's external attack surface. [Learn about MDEASM.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/external-attack-surface-management/overview)

parameters.description: Enable the Internet Attack Surface data connector to start ingesting data into Microsoft Sentinel. If you have a Microsoft EASM workspace, this will be used as the source-of-truth for your assets. If you have more than one, the oldest workspace will be used.
